dialogues.speaker: Xiao
dialogues.text: It's you. Long time no see.

dialogues.speaker: Xiao
dialogues.text: Your stride is carefree, and you seem to be in high spirits. Are you here to sightsee, perhaps?

response.speaker: Xiao
response.text: Photos... I recall Xianyun telling me that you need a Kamera to take those.

response.speaker: Xiao
response.text: Maybe you should check where yours is. Perhaps Paimon dropped it somewhere.

choices.text: I'm here to sightsee and take photos.
